extracted.name: Shokupan Polish Bread (Closed Lid Version)
extracted.description: I’ve been into baking bread for the past few months. It seems to be more fun than cooking only 😁😃 This is one of my favorite recipes I found on Instagram. Super soft shokupan bread 🍞 It’s worth the time to make it. If you like my recipes, please follow my Instagram @jenscookingdiary @jenscookdineandtravel
ingredient_lines: 25 gr heavy cream (can be replaced with whole milk)
instruction_lines: Knead poolish ingredients and dough ingredients until you get 1/2 elastic dough.
Add fat ingredients and knead until you get a silky and super elastic dough.
Let the dough rest and rise for 1-2 hours depending on the room temperature.
Deflate the dough. Divide the dough into 3 portions. Roll out and shape.
Arrange the dough in a 19x10x10cm shokupan pan that has been greased with butter.
Let it rest again for the second time for 1-2 hours depending on the room temperature.
Bake in preheated oven 175C/350F for 30 minutes.
